description: Wasserschutzgebiete Land Salzburg is a dataset listed in inspire.gv.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by static.salzburg.gv.at. Water protection areas of the State of Salzburg, INSPIRE-relevant. Coverage: AT. The portal shows the English title as "Water protection areas Land Salzburg" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Wasserschutzgebiete. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2011-12-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-bmlfuw-at.
